rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Kantei's account 内閣総理大臣の指名, dated 1 November 2017, says that the third reshuffled third Abe cabinet (第３次安倍第３次改造内閣) resigned en masse at that morning's postponed cabinet meeting (午前の繰下げ閣議で総辞職しました).

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same account says that in the afternoon both Houses' plenaries designated 安倍晋三 as the 98th Prime Minister.
